translation: Took place in posad Serock, 30 January 1890, 3 PM. Appeared personally Lejb Uksztukalski, tailor, 49, and Mortka Wolman[?], watchmaker, 50, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 3 PM in posad Serock died a male child named Josek Zajczyk, son of [unclear: Szepa], the mother unknown, four weeks of age. Upon eyewitness certification of the child's death this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and them.
